verdicts.reason: A is the original column shrunk into the middle of the 320×50 banner. The headline, body and CTA are microscopic and unreadable, the white logo bar is a sliver, and about 80% of the canvas is empty navy. B at least uses the banner format, reading left to right with body copy, then headline, then the 'Reserve a Case' button. But the logo and the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow are gone, and the left body copy and 'Ships late June' are too small to read. The headline is jammed into three cramped lines with almost no margin, and the CTA is pressed against the right edge.
